en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 4. It was narrated to me by al-Hassan b. Ahmad from his father from Muhammad b. Ahmad from Sahl b. Ziyad from Ibn Sinan from Hamad b. Uthman from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
Applying Antimony helps hair growth, tears dry up, spit thickens and eyesight improves.”
